Role & Cross-Functional Leadership

Operating at the intersection of technical execution and product strategy, I bridged the gap between our internal delivery teams and external partner agencies.

Key Focus Areas

  • Web Management & Leadership: Managed cross-functional delivery across internal Product Managers, Compliance Teams, Acquisition & Retention Leads, and external marketing agencies.
  • UX Strategy & Architecture: Translated user research and session replays into high-converting, accessible user journeys.
  • Frontend Engineering: Architected and deployed responsive, performant UI components using React, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • CRO & Data Analytics: Designed and validated iterative A/B tests using Optimizely, GA4, Hotjar, and Glassbox.
  • Technical & Content SEO: Optimised information architecture, structured data, headers, and keyword mapping in SEMrush.

The Challenge & Core Objectives

Quantitative analysis revealed a core friction point: while homepage traffic volume was strong, drop-offs spiked when users attempted to navigate into product pages due to sparse product details and unclear value propositions.

Strategic Objectives

  1. Build Immediate Credibility: Modernise the aesthetic to match Equifax’s standing as a trusted financial authority.
  2. Eliminate Conversion Friction: Optimise key product funnels, lower bounce rates, and clarify call-to-action (CTA) hierarchies.
  3. Elevate Organic Visibility: Overhaul technical SEO and product content structure to capture high-intent search traffic.

Phase 1: Discovery, Research & Strategy

We initiated a data-led discovery phase combining qualitative and quantitative inputs:

  • Session Replays & Behavior Analytics (Glassbox & Hotjar): Identified friction points in mobile layouts, hidden navigation elements, and layout shifts that led to rage-clicks.
  • User Surveys & Personas: Partnered with our marketing agency to map distinct user personas and address trust deficit barriers.
  • A/B Testing Framework: Established hypothesis-driven testing streams in Optimizely to validate layout shifts before full deployment.

Phase 2: UX/UI Design, Prototyping & Development

Using findings from the discovery phase, we executed an iterative design and development cycle:

  1. Information Architecture & Wireframing: Simplified global navigation, introducing structured sub-categories and comprehensive FAQ blocks to capture long-tail search intent.
  2. Interactive Prototyping (Figma): Created high-fidelity interactive prototypes to test visual hierarchy, trust signifiers, and CTA contrast ratios.
  3. Frontend Engineering & Accessibility: Built modular, reusable React UI components with strict adherence to WCAG accessibility guidelines and automated testing.
  4. Social Proof Integration: Embedded real-time Trustpilot review widgets directly into user decision points to validate credibility.

Phase 3: Performance & Conversion Results

1. Homepage Transformation

Strategic Note: A minor planned reduction in raw session volume occurred due to strategic traffic redirection toward targeted high-intent landing pages. However, user quality and overall funnel efficiency increased significantly.

Conclusion & Key Takeaways

By combining UX strategy, frontend development, SEO, and CRO methodologies, this overhaul turned an outdated digital footprint into an agile, trustworthy conversion engine.

Key Business Achievements

  • Trust & Compliance Alignment: Successfully integrated social proof (Trustpilot) and regulatory compliance requirements without compromising UX smoothness.
  • SEO Supremacy: Achieved a +139% total keyword ranking increase on core commercial terms.
  • Engineered Efficiency: Standardised frontend components to reduce technical debt and streamline deployment timelines for future product releases.

childMarkdownRemark.excerpt: A Multi-Disciplinary Website Redesign & Optimisation Case Study

childMarkdownRemark.html:
In 2022, Equifax’s web platform faced a significant strategic challenge: high homepage traffic paired with low product engagement and user survey feedback indicating an outdated design that eroded consumer trust.

As the Design and Development Manager, I led a cross-functional initiative spanning UX Design, Frontend Development, Web Management, CRO, and Technical SEO. Over a multi-year effort, we modernised the brand’s digital presence, restructured core user journeys, implemented robust accessibility standards, and drove a +55.4% increase in conversion rate (CvR) on key product landing pages.
